label: Modal position of a PSR: NecessaryPSR says ContingentPSR holds at every accessible world
definition: NecessaryPSR says ContingentPSR holds at every accessible world. WeakPSR says each contingent truth at w has a reason at some accessible world where it is true; that reason need not obtain or explain at w. StableReason says one fact is a reason for f at every world where f is true.
note: Analyst-stated condition for the comparison arena of #755; it is under test, not asserted. A sourced reading would need a pinned witness from the #409 or #365 intake.
